create_ShieldGemma2Config: create a ShieldGemma2Config instance with vision and text sub-configs for initializing a ShieldGemma2 model
build_ShieldGemma2Config_defaults: build a ShieldGemma2Config with default vision config (siglip_vision_model) and text config (gemma3_text) when none are provided
test_ShieldGemma2Config_post_init: test the __post_init__ method converts dict vision and text configs into PreTrainedConfig instances via CONFIG_MAPPING
review_ShieldGemma2Config_attribute_map: review the attribute_map that aliases image_token_id, boi_token_id, and eoi_token_id to their internal names
summarize_ShieldGemma2Config_sub_configs: summarize the sub_configs dict mapping text_config and vision_config to AutoConfig for nested configuration resolution
